notes.title: New Game Witches Brew Is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello there, alchemists and witches! 
[/h3]

We bring you enchanting news today: our newest game, Witches Brew, has just been released on Steam! Head on over to the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]Steam Page [/url][/b]and get the game now! 


Witches Brew is the story of Selene, a coven witch traveling from the big city in search of adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10634171/7ace7e17e3e767bc52b6aaa2b4d3424a8c81bff8.png[/img]
[i]Get ready to dominate potion making and the sexiest girls~[/i]
[hr][/hr]
Gorgeous girls, an enchanting world full of magic and an amazing story all await you! Head on ahead to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008230/Witches_Brew/]The Steam Page[/url][/b] and get the game right now!

I know you’re not a witch yourself, but you still encountered such a magical opportunity. You’re talented.


Dharker Studios

notes.title: Trading Cards now Live
notes.content:
Greetings one and all,

I am happy to announce that the much requested Trading Cards have now been completed and approved and yes released... So trading cards will start dropping as you play.

The set includes the following:

- Standard & Foil Badges
- 5 Collectible Trading Cards
- 5 Collectible Backgrounds
- 5 Character Emoticons

Thank you all for your patience.
& please enjoy them.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
We have just released version 1.11 update for Highschool Romance, which corrects issues that have been brought up to do with the odd character dialogue having the incorrect names in places.

It fixes a number of small bugs that only a tiny tiny minority would have encountered and generally polishes all aspects of the game.

This update also sees the GUI given an extra polish, with version number being shown as well as a help file link. In addition we have added navigation arrows and simply put made everything nicer.

This update also corrects the CG gallery error that has been noted a few times, where the gallery is unlocked from the start, this update should fix that for all new players so they can unlock the gallery normally. It may however not fix it for existing players, or it may remove all currently unlocked images, requiring a replay. Sorry to those it affects.

Last but not least we did a few more revisions within the game itself, edited some more of the dialogue and made some adjustments to the story in places, this again could on a very small minority cause an error to occur when you load a save game. If this occurs try an earlier save point and carry on. We have tried to mitigate this as much as possible.
